record.paper_title: Selected Open Problems in Discrete Geometry and Optimization
record.original_question: For n >= 2, let the Boolean Quadric Polytope P_n be the convex hull, in dimension d = n(n+1)/2, of the 0/1 solutions to x_i x_j = y_ij for all i < j in N = {1,2,...,n}. Find a formula or strong bounds for the d-dimensional volume of P_n.

evidence.quote: Question 8. For n >= 2, the Boolean Quadric Polytope Pn is the convex hull in dimension d = n(n+1)/2 of the 0/1 solutions to xi xj = yij for all i < j in N := {1,2,...,n}. Give a formula or good bounds for the d-dimensional volume of Pn.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \ge 2$ be an integer and set $N = \{1,2,\dots,n\}$ and $d = n(n+1)/2$. The Boolean Quadric Polytope $P_n \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ is defined as the convex hull of all points
$$\bigl(x_1,\dots,x_n,\;(y_{ij})_{1 \le i < j \le n}\bigr) \in \{0,1\}^d$$
that satisfy $y_{ij} = x_i x_j$ for every pair $i < j$ in $N$ (equivalently, $P_n$ is the convex hull of the $2^n$ vectors obtained by letting $(x_1,\dots,x_n)$ range over $\{0,1\}^n$ and setting $y_{ij}=x_i x_j$).

Determine, as a function of $n$, the $d$-dimensional Euclidean volume $\operatorname{vol}_d(P_n)$. Either give a closed-form formula for $\operatorname{vol}_d(P_n)$, or establish strong upper and lower bounds for this volume.
artifact.status_search_result: The literature provides closed-form volume formulas for the standard LP relaxation of the Boolean quadric polytope (the full correlation polytope of K_n) and for sparse cases (stars, paths, cycles), but no formula or strong bounds for the volume of P_n itself appear to be known. The problem of computing or bounding vol_d(P_n) for general n remains open.

status_evidence.title: Volume computation for sparse Boolean quadric relaxations
status_evidence.snippet: Closed-form expression for the volume of a standard relaxation Q(G) of the Boolean quadric polytope; closed-form expressions and asymptotic behaviors for stars, paths, and cycles.
status_evidence.claim: Results exist for volumes of relaxations and sparse cases, not for P_n itself.

status_evidence.title: The Boolean Quadric Polytope (chapter)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey-style chapter on the Boolean quadric polytope discussing facets and relatives.
status_evidence.claim: No general volume formula for P_n is reported.
